title: Recogito
description: An open online platform for text annotation. It allows to easily create a map from an annotated text, by relying on multiple historical gazetteers.

title: QGIS
description: A free software for professional map creation. It comes with a rich graphical interface

title: Leaflet
description: An open-source JavaScript library for mobile-friendly interactive maps. It requires basic programming skills, and can also be used [via the R programming language](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/leaflet/index.html)

title: Carto
description: A commercial platform for interactive map creation. Easy to use, it comes with an intuitive grapical interface

title: geojson.io
description: An online free tool to manually create/modify geojson files (containing geocoded shapes)

title: Map Warper
description: An online free tool to warp historical maps over geocoded locations
